observations: Photo 0: A used automatic transmission/gearbox assembly on the ground; visible stamped/printed label area and a large bellhousing/torque-converter side.
Photo 1: Close-up of the bellhousing/torque-converter ring area with internal components visible; no clear readable part number.
Photo 2: Another angle showing the transmission body and underside; no clear readable model/part number.

identity.kind: Mercedes automatic transmission gearbox (exact model/part number not readable from photos)

claims.claim: Transmissions Gearbox M278 1282 OEM G63, Mercedes transmission gearbox.
claims.evidence: Photos show a Mercedes-style transmission, but the specific code 'M278 1282' / 'OEM G63' is not clearly readable in photo 0/1/2.
No test video, no running/shift proof, and no clear condition evidence in photos 0/1/2.

risks.risk: Wrong transmission variant/part number (seller’s 'M278 1282' claim not readable; could be different Mercedes gearbox family or wrong bellhousing/gear ratio).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the transmission ID/part number plate or stamped code (including the exact 'M278 1282' text) plus the transmission label/serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Mercedes automatic transmission with unknown exact fitment (worst case: not guaranteed for the buyer’s exact G63 application).

risks.risk: Not actually working (seller says it worked, but photos can’t confirm internal condition, solenoids, valve body, or torque converter health).
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox being tested/bench-tested (engage P/R, shift through gears) or a short proof of installation + working drive test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/assumed not working until tested (worst case: needs overhaul or replacement).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories or damage (photos don’t show completeness: wiring harness connectors, sensors, cooler lines fittings, mounting brackets).
risks.proof: Photo checklist: all external sensors/connectors, torque converter condition, cooler line ports, and any included accessories laid out clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: buyer may need extra parts).

risks.risk: Fluid leaks or internal wear not visible (staining/dirt may hide leaks; torque converter/bellhousing wear not confirmable).
risks.proof: Close-up of any wet areas + wipe-clean test: show dry after cleaning and confirm no fresh leaks after a short run.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having unknown leak status (worst case: may leak and require service).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the transmission ID/part number plate or stamped code showing the exact 'M278 1282' (or whatever code is on the unit).
Video proof of operation: shift through gears (P/R/D) or a bench test showing it engages correctly.
Photos of all included items/accessories (sensors, connectors, mounting brackets, cooler line ports) laid out and counted.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a used Mercedes-style automatic transmission, but the exact model/part number needed to price correctly (and to confirm it matches a G63/M278 claim) is not readable, and the 'worked perfectly fine' statement has no test proof.
